abilities.name: Charge
per_rank_text:
Charge an enemy, generate 12 rage, and root it for 1.5 sec.

This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

Roll the dice of fate, providing a random lesser or great combat enhancement for 10 sec. Only one enhancement can be active at the same time.

abilities.name: Cold Snap

Place a feather at the target location, lasting for 15 sec. If allies walk through it, they gain 50% increased movement speed for 4 sec.

Max 3 charges. 20 second recharge timer.

abilities.name: Demonic Leap
per_rank_text: Leap into the air upon demonic wings, moving a short distance. If you reactivate it within 1 sec you will leap again.

abilities.name: Soul Link
per_rank_text:
When active, 20% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Summoned or Enslaved Demon. That damage cannot be prevented. Lasts as long as the demon is active, controlled and you are within 30 yards of it.

@ext:Cannot Soul Link a Summoned Imp.:ext@

Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell, absorbing 75% of the damage dealt by harmful spells (up to a maximum of 50% of your health) and preventing application of harmful magical effects.
